<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // universal for mega--split / mega--news / mega--topics
        const splitPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.mega--split, .mega--news, .mega--topics');

        splitPanels.forEach(function(panel) {
            const tabs = panel.querySelectorAll('.news-rail__link');
            const sections = panel.querySelectorAll('.news-panel');
            const wrapper = panel.querySelector('.news-panels');

            if (!tabs.length) return;

            const isTopicsPanel = panel.classList.contains('mega--topics');

            function isMobileTopics() {
                return isTopicsPanel && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 780px)').matches;
            }

            function setWrapperHeight() {
                if (!wrapper || !sections.length) return;

                if (isMobileTopics()) {
                    wrapper.style.minHeight = '';
                    return;
                }

                let maxH = 0;
                sections.forEach(sec => {
                    const wasHidden = sec.hasAttribute('hidden') || sec.style.display === 'none';
                    if (wasHidden) {
                        sec.removeAttribute('hidden');
                        sec.style.display = 'block';
                    }
                    const h = sec.offsetHeight;
                    if (h > maxH) maxH = h;
                    if (wasHidden && !sec.classList.contains('is-active')) {
                        sec.setAttribute('hidden', 'hidden');
                        sec.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
                if (maxH) wrapper.style.minHeight = maxH + 'px';
            }

            function activate(targetId, btn) {
                if (!sections.length) return;
                tabs.forEach(t => {
                    const active = t === btn;
                    t.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
                    t.setAttribute('aria-selected', active ? 'true' : 'false');
                });
                sections.forEach(sec => {
                    const match = sec.id === targetId;
                    sec.classList.toggle('is-active', match);
                    if (match) {
                        sec.removeAttribute('hidden');
                        sec.style.display = 'block';
                    } else {
                        sec.setAttribute('hidden', 'hidden');
                        sec.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                });
            }

            tabs.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    const target = this.getAttribute('data-target');
                    const href = this.getAttribute('data-href');

                    // mobile topics: redirect
                    if (isMobileTopics()) {
                        if (href && href !== '#') {
                            window.location.href = href;
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    // normal tabs
                    if (target) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        activate(target, this);
                    }
                });

                btn.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
                    const target = this.getAttribute('data-target');
                    const href = this.getAttribute('data-href');

                    if ((e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) {

                        if (isMobileTopics()) {
                            if (href && href !== '#') {
                                window.location.href = href;
                            }
                            return;
                        }

                        if (target) {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            activate(target, this);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });

            setWrapperHeight();

            let resizeTimer;
            window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
                clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
                resizeTimer = setTimeout(setWrapperHeight, 150);
            });
        });
    });
</script>

                                <nav class="article-nav"><h5>In this guide</h5><ul><li><a href="#battery-technologies-and-types">Battery Technologies and Types</a><ul><li><a href="#lithium-ion">Lithium-Ion</a></li><li><a href="#silicon-anode-technology">Silicon Anode Technology</a></li><li><a href="#solid-state-battery-technology">Solid-State Battery Technology</a></li><li><a href="#lithium-iron-phosphate-lifepo4">Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4)</a></li></ul></li><li><a href="#batteries-for-unmanned-applications">Batteries for Unmanned Applications</a><ul><li><a href="#uav-drone-batteries">UAV & Drone Batteries</a></li><li><a href="#usv-uuv-batteries">USV & UUV Batteries</a></li><li><a href="#ugv-batteries">UGV Batteries</a></li></ul></li><li><a href="#system-integration">System Integration</a><li><a href="#battery-management-system-bms">Battery Management System (BMS)</a><li><a href="#making-advanced-battery-technology-work">Making Advanced Battery Technology Work</a></ul></nav>                                <p>The selection of battery technology directly impacts the operational endurance, payload capacity, and mission capabilities of unmanned systems. For manufacturers of batteries and battery packs, production technology must be chosen to meet the specific technical requirements of defense, commercial, and industrial applications. Developments in cell chemistry, component design, and assembly processes directly contribute to power solutions with improved energy density and safety characteristics.</p>
<p>Integrating these next-generation batteries requires a systems-level approach that considers the interplay among the power source, platform, and operational environment. The choice of battery production technology directly affects key performance indicators, including gravimetric and volumetric energy density, charge and discharge rates, cycle life, and thermal stability. As unmanned platforms become more autonomous and mission-critical, the underlying battery manufacturing technologies are a key enabler of performance and reliability.</p>
<h2 id="battery-technologies-and-types">Battery Technologies and Types</h2>
<h3 id="lithium-ion">Lithium-Ion</h3>
<p>Advancements in <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/lithium-ion-batteries/">lithium-ion battery</a> manufacturing focus on optimizing production to meet the specific demands of unmanned systems. Key areas of innovation include improving the consistency of slurry mixing and coating for higher-yield electrode production, and developing faster, more precise automated assembly for pouch, prismatic, and cylindrical cells. These refinements aim to enhance cell-to-cell consistency, increase throughput, and reduce manufacturing costs for high-performance batteries.</p>
<h3 id="silicon-anode-technology">Silicon Anode Technology</h3>
<p>Silicon anode technology represents a significant advancement in lithium-ion battery design, offering the potential for a substantial increase in energy density compared to traditional graphite anodes. By incorporating silicon, batteries can store more lithium ions, leading to longer runtimes and lighter power packs for unmanned systems. The manufacturing challenge lies in managing the volumetric expansion of silicon during charging and discharging cycles to ensure long-term stability and cycle life.</p>
<h3 id="solid-state-battery-technology">Solid-State Battery Technology</h3>
<p><a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/solid-state-batteries/">Solid-state batteries</a> replace the liquid electrolyte found in conventional lithium-ion batteries with a solid material, such as a ceramic or polymer. This architectural change enhances safety by eliminating flammable liquid electrolytes and can enable higher energy densities and a longer lifespan. The development of solid-state battery manufacturing is a key focus for next-generation batteries, promising significant performance gains for UAVs and other unmanned platforms.</p>
<h3 id="lithium-iron-phosphate-lifepo4">Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4)</h3>
<p>Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4 or LFP) is a cathode material known for its exceptional thermal and chemical stability, making it a very safe lithium-ion chemistry. While offering a lower nominal voltage and energy density than some other lithium-ion types, LiFePO4 batteries provide a very long cycle life and high peak power ratings. These characteristics make them suitable for high-current applications in UGVs and USVs where safety and longevity are paramount.</p>
<h2 id="batteries-for-unmanned-applications">Batteries for Unmanned Applications</h2>
<p>Batteries designed for unmanned applications must meet specific performance criteria not found in general-purpose cells. These requirements include high energy density for extended endurance, high discharge rates for demanding flight or subsea maneuvers, and robust construction for resilience to shock and vibration. Lightweight batteries for UAVs are essential for maximizing flight time and payload capacity, while power sources for UUVs and USVs require specialized sealing and pressure tolerance.</p>
<h3 id="uav-drone-batteries">UAV & Drone Batteries</h3>
<p>Powering <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/unmanned-aerial-vehicles/">unmanned aerial vehicles</a>, from small surveillance drones to large HAPS platforms, requires high-energy-density, lightweight, and reliable batteries. Key technologies include <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/lithium-polymer-lipo-batteries/">lithium-polymer (LiPo)</a> and advanced lithium-ion cells that offer superior performance-to-weight ratios. Manufacturing focuses on precision assembly and quality control to ensure safety and consistent output during critical flight phases.</p>
<h3 id="usv-uuv-batteries">USV & UUV Batteries</h3>
<p>Batteries for <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/unmanned-surface-vehicles-usv/">Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs)</a> and <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/unmanned-underwater-vehicles-uuv/">Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs)</a> operate in harsh marine environments. Production requires robust battery casing, corrosion-resistant connectors, and effective thermal management systems. Technologies such as LiFePO4 are often selected for their stability and long cycle life, which are critical for long-duration subsea and surface missions.</p>
<h3 id="ugv-batteries">UGV Batteries</h3>
<p><a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/unmanned-ground-vehicle-ugv-manufacturers/">Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs)</a> require durable, <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/high-capacity-batteries/">high-capacity battery packs</a> to power their traction systems, sensors, and payloads over extended periods. Battery manufacturing for UGVs focuses on ruggedization, thermal stability, and efficient power delivery. <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/custom-batteries/">Custom battery packs</a> are often developed to fit specific vehicle chassis and mission profiles.</p>
<h2 id="system-integration">System Integration</h2>
<p>Integrating advanced battery packs into unmanned systems requires careful consideration of mechanical, electrical, and data interfaces. The battery must be securely housed and connected to the vehicle’s power distribution bus, while the BMS communicates with the main flight controller or vehicle control unit.</p>
<p>Key integration points include:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/gnss-ins/">GNSS/INS</a>: A stable, reliable power supply is critical to the continuous operation of navigation systems. The BMS must ensure voltage and current remain within safe limits to prevent system resets or failures.</li>
<li>Communications: Secure data links and <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/command-and-control/">command-and-control</a> radios depend on clean, uninterrupted power from the battery system.</li>
<li>Payloads: <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/cameras/">High-resolution cameras</a>, <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/lidar-for-autonomous-vehicles/">LiDAR scanners</a>, and other advanced sensors require significant power. The battery and BMS must be able to handle high-current demands from multiple payloads simultaneously.</li>
<li>Control Systems: The flight controller or vehicle computer relies on precise battery data, such as state of charge and temperature, from the BMS to manage missions and execute emergency procedures, such as return-to-home.</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="battery-management-system-bms">Battery Management System (BMS)</h2>
<p>A <a href="https://www.unmannedsystemstechnology.com/expo/battery-management-systems-bms/">Battery Management System (BMS)</a> is an essential electronic system that monitors and manages a rechargeable battery pack. Its primary functions include balancing cells, monitoring state of charge (SoC), and protecting the battery from operating outside its safe voltage, current, and temperature parameters. For unmanned systems, the BMS is a critical component for ensuring the safety, reliability, and longevity of the power source.</p>
<h2 id="making-advanced-battery-technology-work">Making Advanced Battery Technology Work</h2>
<p>The performance of next-generation unmanned systems is intrinsically linked to the underlying battery technology that powers them. For manufacturers, mastering advanced production techniques for silicon anodes, solid-state electrolytes, and other emerging chemistries is critical to delivering the energy density, safety, and reliability required by UAV, UUV, and UGV platforms. By partnering with specialist suppliers and leveraging cutting-edge manufacturing technology, battery producers can create high-performance power solutions that enable longer missions, heavier payloads, and more complex autonomous operations.</p>

    .top-section-grid-right---column {

    }

    /* Keyframes */
    @keyframes floatUp {
        from {
            transform: translateY(28px);
            opacity: 0;
            filter: blur(4px);
        }

        to {
            transform: translateY(0);
            opacity: 1;
            filter: blur(0);
        }
    }

    @keyframes floatDown {
        from {
            transform: translateY(-28px);
            opacity: 0;
            filter: blur(4px);
        }

        to {
            transform: translateY(0);
            opacity: 1;
            filter: blur(0);
        }
    }

/* Overview images with captions */
.wp-caption {
    background: #fafafa; /* subtle background for clarity on white images */

    border-radius: 6px;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 100%; /* responsive */
}

.wp-caption img {
    width: 100%; /* scales to container */
    height: auto;
    border-radius: 4px;
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.wp-caption-text {
    font-size: 16px; /* slightly smaller than body for captions */
    color: #555;
    border-top: 1px solid #eee;
    padding-top: 0.5em;
    margin-top: 0.5em;
    line-height: 1.4;

    display: block;

    float: left;
    margin: 0 35px 35px 0; /* top, right, bottom, left */

.wp-caption-text {
    font-size: 16px;

    // Shuffles the platinum images in the hero, and animates the image columns into position
    (function() {

        const count = Math.min(slots.length, items.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

<script>
    // Changes each of the images every few seconds, so that each supplier gets some air time
    (function() {
        const dataEl = document.getElementById('product-grid-json');
        if (!dataEl) return;
        let pool;
        try {
            pool = JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent || '[]');
        } catch (e) {
            pool = [];
        }
        if (!Array.isArray(pool) || pool.length === 0) return;

        // Shuffle pool initially
        pool.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);

        const slots = document.querySelectorAll('.top-section---grid-right .tile-link');
        if (!slots.length) return;

        let pointer = 0;

        function nextItem() {
            const item = pool[pointer % pool.length];
            pointer++;
            return item;
        }

        // Initial fill
        slots.forEach(slot => {
            const {
                src,
                href,
                alt
            } = nextItem();
            const img = slot.querySelector('img');
            slot.href = href;
            if (img) {
                img.src = src;
                img.alt = alt || '';
                img.classList.add('showing');
            }
        });

        // Crossfade helper
        function crossfade(slot, newItem) {
            const oldImg = slot.querySelector('img.showing');
            const newImg = document.createElement('img');
            newImg.className = 'border-radius-8px showing';
            newImg.src = newItem.src;
            newImg.alt = newItem.alt || '';
            newImg.loading = "lazy";
            newImg.style.opacity = 0; // start transparent

            slot.href = newItem.href;
            slot.appendChild(newImg);

            // trigger fade in
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                newImg.style.opacity = 1;
            });

            // fade out old
            if (oldImg) {
                oldImg.classList.remove('showing');
                oldImg.classList.add('fading');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (oldImg.parentNode) oldImg.remove();
                }, 900); // after transition
            }
        }

        // Custom sequence of slot indices (0-based)
        // DOM order: [col1img1, col1img2, col2img1, col2img2, col2img3, col3img1, col3img2]
        const sequence = [
            3, // col2 img2
            1, // col1 img2
            2, // col2 img1
            6, // col3 img2
            0, // col1 img1
            4, // col2 img3
            5 // col3 img1


        ];

        let seqIndex = 0;

        // Start cycling after 5s
        setTimeout(() => {
            setInterval(() => {
                const slotIndex = sequence[seqIndex];
                const slot = slots[slotIndex];
                if (slot) {
                    crossfade(slot, nextItem());
                }
                seqIndex = (seqIndex + 1) % sequence.length;
            }, 4000); // one slot every 4s
        }, 2000); // wait 5s before first change
    })();
</script>

<script>
    class GridDisplayToggle {
        gridDisplayClass = 'ebt-expo-categories__supplier-grid--grid'
        selectedOptionClass = 'ebt-expo-categories__suppliers-format-choice--selected'

        constructor(controlSelector, containerSelector) {
            this.controls = document.querySelectorAll(controlSelector)
            this.container = document.querySelector(containerSelector)
            this.addEventListeners()
        }

        addEventListeners() {
            if (!this.controls) {
                return;
            }

            this.controls.forEach((element) => {
                element.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
                    const currentControl = event.currentTarget;
                    event.preventDefault();
                    this.selectControl(currentControl);
                    this.selectFormat(currentControl.dataset.format);
                });
            });
        }

        selectControl(control) {
            this.controls.forEach((element) => {
                element.classList.remove(this.selectedOptionClass);
            });

            control.classList.add(this.selectedOptionClass);
        }

        selectFormat(format) {
            switch (format) {
                case 'grid':
                    this.container.classList.add(this.gridDisplayClass);
                    break;
                case 'list':
                    this.container.classList.remove(this.gridDisplayClass);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }

    new GridDisplayToggle('.ebt-expo-categories__suppliers-format-choice', '.ebt-expo-categories__supplier-grid')

<script>
/**
 * Dealfront outbound click tracking (final - scheme removed from dest)
 *
 * Tracks external link clicks by firing Dealfront virtual pageviews:
 *  - Normal outbound:
 *      [current-page-origin+pathname]/url-click/[dest-host]/?dest=dest-host/dest-path
 *  - Banner outbound (inside any ancestor with class ".g"):
 *      [current-page-origin+pathname]/banner-click/[adid-<id>]/[dest-host]/?dest=dest-host/dest-path
 *
 * Destination rule:
 *  - dest includes ONLY hostname + pathname (NO scheme, NO query params, NO fragment)
 *    Examples:
 *      https://www.dynautics.com/products/?pid=123&src=xyz  -> www.dynautics.com/products
 *      http://example.com/abc#section                       -> example.com/abc
 *
 * Other behaviors:
 *  - Tags all external http/https links on load (and dynamically added links):
 *      - Adds target="_blank" if missing
 *      - Adds rel="noopener noreferrer" if missing
 *      - Stores dest in data-target-domain
 *      - Marks banner clicks if inside .g
 *      - Extracts ad id from nearest ancestor class a-<id> and stores data-df-adid="adid-###"
 *
 * Fail-safe:
 *  - If Dealfront isn't available / blocked, nothing breaks; links still open normally.
 */

(function () {
  "use strict";

  // -----------------------------
  // Optional debug
  // -----------------------------
  var DEBUG = false; // set true temporarily if needed
  function log() {
    if (!DEBUG || !window.console) return;
    try { console.log.apply(console, arguments); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function warn() {
    if (!DEBUG || !window.console) return;
    try { console.warn.apply(console, arguments); } catch (e) {}
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // Config
  // -----------------------------
  // Add this attribute to any <a> to skip tracking:
  // <a data-no-dealfront ...>
  var SKIP_ATTR = "data-no-dealfront";

  // Banner detection: any ancestor with class ".g"
  var BANNER_WRAPPER_SELECTOR = ".g";

  // Ad id extraction: any ancestor class like "a-715"
  var AD_CLASS_PREFIX = "a-";

  // Internal markers
  var MARK_OUTBOUND = "data-df-outbound";
  var MARK_BANNER  = "data-df-bann";
  var MARK_ADID    = "data-df-adid";
  var MARK_DEST    = "data-target-domain";

  // -----------------------------
  // Helpers
  // -----------------------------
  function isHttpUrl(u) {
    return u && (u.protocol === "http:" || u.protocol === "https:");
  }

  function isExternal(urlObj) {
    return urlObj.origin !== window.location.origin;
  }

  // Destination includes ONLY hostname + pathname (no scheme, no query, no hash)
  function destHostAndPathOnly(urlObj) {
    var u = new URL(urlObj.href);
    u.hash = "";
    u.search = ""; // drop ALL query params

    // Normalize trailing slash (optional): keep root "/", remove elsewhere
    if (u.pathname.length > 1 && u.pathname.endsWith("/")) {
      u.pathname = u.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "");
    }

    // No scheme here — avoids ":" which tends to get displayed encoded in tools
    return u.hostname + u.pathname;
  }

  function ensureTargetBlankAndRel(a) {
    if (!a.getAttribute("target")) a.setAttribute("target", "_blank");

    var rel = (a.getAttribute("rel") || "").trim();
    var relParts = rel ? rel.split(/\s+/) : [];
    var relSet = new Set(relParts.map(function (x) { return x.toLowerCase(); }));

    if (!relSet.has("noopener")) relSet.add("noopener");
    if (!relSet.has("noreferrer")) relSet.add("noreferrer");

    a.setAttribute("rel", Array.from(relSet).join(" ").trim());
  }

  // Base URL for tracking to prevent double slashes:
  // origin + pathname, trailing slashes removed (except root)
  function normalizeCurrentPageBase() {
    try {
      var cur = new URL(window.location.href);
      cur.hash = "";

      var base = cur.origin + cur.pathname;

      if (base.length > cur.origin.length + 1) {
        base = base.replace(/\/+$/, "");
      }

      return base;
    } catch (e) {
      return (window.location.href || "").replace(/\/+$/, "");
    }
  }

  function getHostFromDest(dest) {
    // dest format: "example.com/path/..."
    try {
      return (dest.split("/")[0] || "unknown-host");
    } catch (e) {
      return "unknown-host";
    }
  }

  function isBannerLink(a) {
    try {
      return !!(a.closest && a.closest(BANNER_WRAPPER_SELECTOR));
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // Find nearest ancestor with class like "a-715", return "715" or null
  function getBannerAdIdNumber(a) {
    try {
      var el = a;
      while (el && el.nodeType === 1) {
        if (el.classList && el.classList.length) {
          for (var i = 0; i < el.classList.length; i++) {
            var cls = el.classList[i];
            if (cls && cls.indexOf(AD_CLASS_PREFIX) === 0) {
              var id = cls.slice(AD_CLASS_PREFIX.length);
              if (/^\d+$/.test(id)) return id;
            }
          }
        }
        el = el.parentElement;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
  }

  function fireDealfrontPageview(pageUrl, pageTitle) {
    try {
      if (window.ldfdr && typeof window.ldfdr.pageview === "function") {
        window.ldfdr.pageview({
          pageUrl: pageUrl,
          pageTitle: pageTitle || document.title
        });
        log("[Dealfront] pageview:", pageUrl);
        return true;
      } else {
        warn("[Dealfront] ldfdr.pageview unavailable (blocked/not loaded).");
        return false;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      warn("[Dealfront] Error calling ldfdr.pageview:", e);
      return false;
    }
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // Tagging
  // -----------------------------
  function tagOutboundLinks(root) {
    var links = (root || document).querySelectorAll("a[href]");
    var tagged = 0;

    for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
      var a = links[i];

      if (a.getAttribute(MARK_OUTBOUND) === "1") continue;
      if (a.hasAttribute(SKIP_ATTR)) continue;

      var href = a.getAttribute("href");
      if (!href) continue;

      // Skip non-web links
      if (
        href.startsWith("#") ||
        href.startsWith("mailto:") ||
        href.startsWith("tel:") ||
        href.startsWith("javascript:")
      ) {
        continue;
      }

      var urlObj;
      try { urlObj = new URL(a.href, window.location.href); }
      catch (e) { continue; }

      if (!isHttpUrl(urlObj)) continue;
      if (!isExternal(urlObj)) continue;

      // Ensure opens in new tab for reliability
      ensureTargetBlankAndRel(a);

      // Store destination as host+path only (no scheme/query/hash)
      var dest = destHostAndPathOnly(urlObj);
      a.setAttribute(MARK_DEST, dest);

      // Mark outbound so click handler can ignore internals
      a.setAttribute(MARK_OUTBOUND, "1");

      // Banner flag + ad id
      if (isBannerLink(a)) {
        a.setAttribute(MARK_BANNER, "1");
        var idNum = getBannerAdIdNumber(a);
        if (idNum) a.setAttribute(MARK_ADID, "adid-" + idNum);
      }

      tagged++;
    }

    if (DEBUG && tagged > 0) log("[Dealfront] Tagged outbound links:", tagged);
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // Click handler
  // -----------------------------
  function handleClicks(e) {
    var a = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest("a[href]") : null;
    if (!a) return;
    if (a.hasAttribute(SKIP_ATTR)) return;

    // Only track links we tagged as outbound externals
    if (a.getAttribute(MARK_OUTBOUND) !== "1") return;

    var dest = a.getAttribute(MARK_DEST);
    if (!dest) return;

    var base = normalizeCurrentPageBase();
    var banner = (a.getAttribute(MARK_BANNER) === "1") || isBannerLink(a);

    var host = getHostFromDest(dest);

    // dest is now simple "host/path" (no ? & # :), so it’s readable and safe unencoded
    var destPart = dest;

    var virtualUrl, title;

    if (banner) {
      var adId = a.getAttribute(MARK_ADID);
      if (!adId) {
        var idNum = getBannerAdIdNumber(a);
        adId = idNum ? ("adid-" + idNum) : "adid-unknown";
      }

      virtualUrl =
        base +
        "/banner-click/" +
        encodeURIComponent(adId) +
        "/" +
        encodeURIComponent(host) +
        "/dest/" +
        destPart;

      title = "Banner click (" + adId + "): " + dest;
    } else {
      virtualUrl =
        base +
        "/url-click/" +
        encodeURIComponent(host) +
        "/dest/" +
        destPart;

      title = "URL click: " + dest;
    }

    fireDealfrontPageview(virtualUrl, title);
  }

  // -----------------------------
  // Init
  // -----------------------------
  function init() {
    tagOutboundLinks(document);
    document.addEventListener("click", handleClicks, true);

    // Tag dynamically added content (ads, builders, infinite scroll)
    if (window.MutationObserver) {
      var obs = new MutationObserver(function (mutations) {
        for (var i = 0; i < mutations.length; i++) {
          var m = mutations[i];
          for (var j = 0; j < m.addedNodes.length; j++) {
            var node = m.addedNodes[j];
            if (node && node.nodeType === 1) tagOutboundLinks(node);
          }
        }
      });
      obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

The selection of battery technology directly impacts the operational endurance, payload capacity, and mission capabilities of unmanned systems. For manufacturers of batteries and battery packs, production technology must be chosen to meet the specific technical requirements of defense, commercial, and industrial applications. Developments in cell chemistry, component design, and assembly processes directly contribute to power solutions with improved energy density and safety characteristics.

Integrating these next-generation batteries requires a systems-level approach that considers the interplay among the power source, platform, and operational environment. The choice of battery production technology directly affects key performance indicators, including gravimetric and volumetric energy density, charge and discharge rates, cycle life, and thermal stability. As unmanned platforms become more autonomous and mission-critical, the underlying battery manufacturing technologies are a key enabler of performance and reliability.

Battery Technologies and Types

Lithium-Ion

Advancements in lithium-ion battery manufacturing focus on optimizing production to meet the specific demands of unmanned systems. Key areas of innovation include improving the consistency of slurry mixing and coating for higher-yield electrode production, and developing faster, more precise automated assembly for pouch, prismatic, and cylindrical cells. These refinements aim to enhance cell-to-cell consistency, increase throughput, and reduce manufacturing costs for high-performance batteries.

Silicon Anode Technology

Silicon anode technology represents a significant advancement in lithium-ion battery design, offering the potential for a substantial increase in energy density compared to traditional graphite anodes. By incorporating silicon, batteries can store more lithium ions, leading to longer runtimes and lighter power packs for unmanned systems. The manufacturing challenge lies in managing the volumetric expansion of silicon during charging and discharging cycles to ensure long-term stability and cycle life.

Solid-State Battery Technology

Solid-state batteries replace the liquid electrolyte found in conventional lithium-ion batteries with a solid material, such as a ceramic or polymer. This architectural change enhances safety by eliminating flammable liquid electrolytes and can enable higher energy densities and a longer lifespan. The development of solid-state battery manufacturing is a key focus for next-generation batteries, promising significant performance gains for UAVs and other unmanned platforms.

Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4)

Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4 or LFP) is a cathode material known for its exceptional thermal and chemical stability, making it a very safe lithium-ion chemistry. While offering a lower nominal voltage and energy density than some other lithium-ion types, LiFePO4 batteries provide a very long cycle life and high peak power ratings. These characteristics make them suitable for high-current applications in UGVs and USVs where safety and longevity are paramount.

Batteries for Unmanned Applications

Batteries designed for unmanned applications must meet specific performance criteria not found in general-purpose cells. These requirements include high energy density for extended endurance, high discharge rates for demanding flight or subsea maneuvers, and robust construction for resilience to shock and vibration. Lightweight batteries for UAVs are essential for maximizing flight time and payload capacity, while power sources for UUVs and USVs require specialized sealing and pressure tolerance.

UAV & Drone Batteries

Powering unmanned aerial vehicles, from small surveillance drones to large HAPS platforms, requires high-energy-density, lightweight, and reliable batteries. Key technologies include lithium-polymer (LiPo) and advanced lithium-ion cells that offer superior performance-to-weight ratios. Manufacturing focuses on precision assembly and quality control to ensure safety and consistent output during critical flight phases.

USV & UUV Batteries

Batteries for Unmanned Surface Vehicles (USVs) and Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) operate in harsh marine environments. Production requires robust battery casing, corrosion-resistant connectors, and effective thermal management systems. Technologies such as LiFePO4 are often selected for their stability and long cycle life, which are critical for long-duration subsea and surface missions.

UGV Batteries

Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) require durable, high-capacity battery packs to power their traction systems, sensors, and payloads over extended periods. Battery manufacturing for UGVs focuses on ruggedization, thermal stability, and efficient power delivery. Custom battery packs are often developed to fit specific vehicle chassis and mission profiles.

System Integration

Integrating advanced battery packs into unmanned systems requires careful consideration of mechanical, electrical, and data interfaces. The battery must be securely housed and connected to the vehicle’s power distribution bus, while the BMS communicates with the main flight controller or vehicle control unit.

Key integration points include:

GNSS/INS: A stable, reliable power supply is critical to the continuous operation of navigation systems. The BMS must ensure voltage and current remain within safe limits to prevent system resets or failures.

Communications: Secure data links and command-and-control radios depend on clean, uninterrupted power from the battery system.

Payloads: High-resolution cameras, LiDAR scanners, and other advanced sensors require significant power. The battery and BMS must be able to handle high-current demands from multiple payloads simultaneously.

Control Systems: The flight controller or vehicle computer relies on precise battery data, such as state of charge and temperature, from the BMS to manage missions and execute emergency procedures, such as return-to-home.

Battery Management System (BMS)

A Battery Management System (BMS) is an essential electronic system that monitors and manages a rechargeable battery pack. Its primary functions include balancing cells, monitoring state of charge (SoC), and protecting the battery from operating outside its safe voltage, current, and temperature parameters. For unmanned systems, the BMS is a critical component for ensuring the safety, reliability, and longevity of the power source.

Making Advanced Battery Technology Work

The performance of next-generation unmanned systems is intrinsically linked to the underlying battery technology that powers them. For manufacturers, mastering advanced production techniques for silicon anodes, solid-state electrolytes, and other emerging chemistries is critical to delivering the energy density, safety, and reliability required by UAV, UUV, and UGV platforms. By partnering with specialist suppliers and leveraging cutting-edge manufacturing technology, battery producers can create high-performance power solutions that enable longer missions, heavier payloads, and more complex autonomous operations.
